Commentary.Commentary: We are back for the chase! The Zimbabwe players are out there in the middle. Litton Das and Parvez Hossain Emon are the openers for Bangladesh. Brad Evans will start with the ball for Zimbabwe. Here we go...
...THE RUN CHASE…

Bangladesh would be quite satisfied with their bowling effort on a whole. This is a good batting wicket and they have restricted their opponents to an achievable target. They were a bit expensive to start off but once Mahedi Hasan scalped two in two deliveries the Zimbabwe top order simply collapsed. Sikandar Raza departed on a duck and it looked like Bangladesh were going to wrap up the innings in quick time. They will be disappointed that there were unable to restrict the two lower-order batters and will now be looking to come out and seal this game and series. All bowlers were amongst the wickets and except for the hiccup towards the end of the innings, Bangladesh will be pretty satisfied with their performance.

Zimbabwe after winning the toss started off with positive intent. They were going at a good rate but the top order collapsed once more. Ryan Burl and Luke Jongwe put on a partnership of 79 runs in just 31 balls to take Zimbabwe to a reasonable total. The onslaught started when Ryan Burl decided to go after Nasum Ahmed in the 15th over and plundered him for 34 runs. He departed on 54 having faced 28 deliveries with 6 maximums against his name. The Zimbabwe innings fell away once more after he departed and now the bowlers will have to come out with fire to defend this total.

What a game this has been so far! There have been more twists and turns than a fiction thriller! This game looked dusted at the end of 13 overs with Zimbabwe struggling on 67 having lost 6 wickets. Ryan Burl and Luke Jongwe had other ideas and in the end, Zimbabwe have managed to reach a competitive total of 156. The game is well and truly on!

Afif Hossain drops a catch and the batters run three. This is a fuller delivery and outside off. Evans slices it to deep point where Afif Hossain running to his left drops a catch. The batters run three as Afif Hossain takes time to throw it back to the keeper. Anamul Haque collects the ball and throws it to the bowler's end and it hits Mustafizur Rahman on leg. The ball deflects away and there is a chance for the fourth run as well but Victor Nyauchi has run well past the stumps. So, Zimbabwe finish with 156/8 after 20 overs!
Swing and a miss! On the shorter side and it is angled across the batter. Evans swings across the line but misses.
Back of a length and it is a slower one again. Victor Nyauchi swings hard but gets a toe-end of his blade. The ball goes right of the keeper and a single is taken.
On the shorter side, on off. Evans pulls it off the top edge of his blade. The ball falls just short of the deep square leg fielder and a single is taken.

This is a slower length delivery, outside off. Victor Nyauchi throws his bat at it again but misses. The ball goes off the bounce to the keeper and the batters run for a bye. The umpire though check for a run-out at the bowler's end as the throw was quick from the keeper to Mustafizur Rahman and he fires a direct-hit at the bowler's end. The replays show that the batter is well in.
On a length and outside off. Victor Nyauchi swings his blade but misses.

OUT! CAUGHT! Ryan Burl departs! It has been a brilliant knock from the left-hander and he has taken his team to a fighting score here. On a length, on off. Burl looks to hit it down the ground. However, the ball hits the bottom of his blade and it seems to be broken again. The ball goes in the air towards long on. Litton Das there settles under it and takes the catch comfortably. Victor Nyauchi is the next batter in.
Commentary.Howout: c Litton Das b Hasan Mahmud

Commentary.Commentary: Good running! This is on a fullish length and outside off. Burl hits it wide of long off for a couple.
Play and a miss! Back of a length and angling across the batter. Burl slashes at it hard but misses.
Back of a length, on leg. Evans clips it to deep backward square leg for a single.
A fuller delivery on off. Burl drills it to long off for a single.
Brad Evans has walked out to the middle.

OUT! CAUGHT! Finally the partnership has been broken but Luke Jongwe has done a superb job here. This is on a length and outside off. Luke Jongwe looks to power it straight down the ground. However, he gets a top edge of his blade and the ball goes in the air behind cover. Mosaddek Hossain moves to his back and completes a fine catch.
Commentary.Howout: c Mosaddek Hossain b Hasan Mahmud

Commentary.Commentary: Good smart bowling! Nails a wide yorker, outside off. Luke Jongwe only manages to dig it out to point and takes a single. 9 from the over! Can Zimbabwe reach 170 here?
On the shorter side, around off. Luke Jongwe slaps it to deep extra-cover for a couple.
Mustafizur Rahman cleverly bowls this outisde off. Tad slower in pace too on a fullish length. Luke Jongwe looks to drive it away but misses.
SIX! Stand and deliver! Fizz after bowling two dot deliveries, bowls this in the slot, on off. Luke Jongwe stays deep in his crease and hammers it straight down the ground for a biggie.
Another dot ball! Mustafizur Rahman bangs it short and around leg. Luke Jongwe looks to hook it but misses.
On a length and outside off. It is angled across the batter. Luke Jongwe looks to cut it but misses.

SIX! Ryan Burl gets to his fifty and gets to it in style! What a knock this has been, he is taking his team to a good fighting total here. Hasan bowls it in the slot, on middle and Burl just launches it over deep mid-wicket for a biggie.
WIDE! He bowls it wider outside off and Burl lets it go.
This is outside off and fuller. Luke Jongwe drills it to deep extra-cover for a single.
SIX! Luke Jongwe gets into the act now! This is on middle and Jongwe gets under it to tonk it over deep mid-wicket for a biggie.
This is outside off and quicker. Luke Jongwe looks to drive it away but misses.

A fumble in the deep allows a second. This is fuller on middle. Luke Jongwe slogs it to deep mid-wicket. The fielder in the deep runs to his left. However, fails to collect it cleanly on one go and the batters run two.
Goes fuller on leg. Burl works it to deep mid-wicket for a single.
Mahedi Hasan is back on.

FOUR! Back-to-back boundaries! Much more control on this one! Hasan Mahmud pulls his length back a bit but there is still width on offer, Luke Jongwe places this past the point fielder as it speeds away to the deep point fence. Luke Jongwe is playing quite a cameo here and these two are taking Zimbabwe to a fighting total! 10 runs from the over!

FOUR! Luke Jongwe's swinging has finally yielded a boundary! Hasan Mahmud goes full once again outside off, Luke Jongwe swings his bat and gets a thick outside edge that flies over point. The ball runs away to the vacant deep point region for a boundary​​! Luke Jongwe wants to be a part of this ball-hitting party!
This is a fraction full and pitching on middle and leg, Ryan Burl knocks this down to long on for a single.
This is on a good length and outside off, Ryan Burl taps it towards short mid-wicket and Hasan Mahmud has started this over well.
Serves this a fraction full and outside off, Luke Jongwe swings and connects this time but only manages an outside edge to third man for a single.
Hasan Mahmud begins with a short ball wide outside off, Luke Jongwe looks to upper cut this and gets beaten.

SIX! 34 runs from the over. This is some incredible hitting by Ryan Burl. Nasum Ahmed bowls this quicker and on off, keeps it away from the batter, Ryan Burl stays in his crease and tries to reach out for but ends up slicing it, still the power of his shoulders takes this over wide long off for a biggie. The crowd are on their feet and rightly so. The broken bat has worked in favour of Ryan Burl.

FOUR! Not a six but still gets a boundary here. This is darted full and on middle, Ryan Burl lofts it towards the long off fence. The fielder there dives to his right but cannot stop it as it his hit firmly. One bounce and over the ropes.

SIX! This is unbelievable hitting. This is short again and on middle, Ryan Burl goes for the same shot and gets the desired result as he smokes it over deep mid-wicket again and it sails over. With that, the 100 comes up for Zimbabwe.
SIX! Make that three in a row! Nasum Ahmed comes 'round the wicket and bowls short again and on middle, Ryan Burl stands tall and pulls it hard over the deep mid-wicket fence for another biggie.
SIX! Back-to-back maximums for Burl. Nasum Ahmed pulls his length back a bit and on middle, Ryan Burl heaves it over the deep square leg fence for a maximum.
SIX! This is huge! This is tossed up full and on off, it is in the slot, Ryan Burl stays in his crease and smokes it over the long on fence for a biggie.
Nasum Ahmed is back into the attack. He got a wicket in the only over he bowled so far.
Hasan Mahmud goes a fraction full and outside off. This one also comes into the batter and beats him on the inside edge. Good comeback in the over after conceding two early boundaries.
This is served on a good length and outside off. Nips back in slightly as Luke Jongwe fends this solidly back to the bowler.
Hasan Mahmud bangs this one in short and angles this down leg, Luke Jongwe ducks under this one and looks for a wide. Not given.

FOUR! Two in a row! Albeit a misfield! Hasan Mahmud goes full outside off and Luke Jongwe works this towards deep point. Really casual from the fielder as he takes his eye off the ball and its runs through his hands to the fence for four more runs! Useful runs here for Zimbabwe!

FOUR! Luke Jongwe is off the mark in quite a fashion! This is on a length and in line with the stumps, Luke Jongwe gets down the wicket and thumps it over the mid off fielder. Does not get a hold of this one but still manages to clear the fielder as it runs away to the long off fence for a boundary!
Hasan Mahmud begins with a good length delivery on the pads, Ryan Burl clips this towards deep backward square leg for a single.
Luke Jongwe walks out to the middle now as we have another bowling change. Hasan Mahmud is back on. He has also bowled only one over so far which went for five runs.

OUT! CAUGHT BEHIND! A blinder of a catch by Anamul Haque to send Milton Shumba back in the hut. This is on a good length and on off, Milton Shumba looks to defend at it but gets a thick outside edge towards the keeper. Anamul Haque there dives to his left and takes a superb one-handed catch.
Commentary.Howout: c Anamul Haque b Mustafizur Rahman

Commentary.Commentary: Full and on middle, Milton Shumba knocks it to the leg side.

An appeal for LBW but turned down. This is quick and full on middle and off, Milton Shumba looks to flick it away but gets hit high on his pads. There is an appeal for LBW but the umpire is not interested.
We have got a broken bat there. This is full and on off, Ryan Burl charges down the pitch to heave it to the leg side but the ball hits the toe end of the bat and goes towards mid-wicket. They cross.
Sharp bouncer! He bangs in this short and on middle, Ryan Burl ducks under it.
Starts with a length ball and onto the pads, Milton Shumba tucks it away through square leg for one.
Mustafizur Rahman is back on. One over for six runs so far.

FOUR! Gets a hold of this one! Mahmudullah goes wide outside off and bowls this short as well. Ryan Burl is on his back foot in a flash as he carves this towards deep point fence for a much-needed boundary!
Mahmudullah goes short outside off, Ryan Burl goes back in the crease and thumps it straight to covers.
Flights this one full outside off, Milton Shumba knocks this down to long off for a run.
A fraction short and outside off, Ryan Burl shuffles down the wicket and guides the ball to deep point for a single.
This is on the pads from a fuller length, Milton Shumba clips this to deep backward square leg for a single.
Mahmudullah serves a full delivery angled into the stumps, Milton Shumba nudges it towards mid-wicket.
Full again and on off, this is pushed to covers.
Tossed up full and on off, Milton Shumba gets to the pitch of the ball and eases it towards long off for one.
Floats it up on middle, Milton Shumba leans on and defends it well.
A bit short and sliding down the leg, Ryan Burl helps it behind square on the leg side for a single.
Tossed up full and on middle, Ryan Burl blocks it down the pitch.
Flatter and quicker down the leg, Ryan Burl flicks it towards square leg where Hasan Mahmud dives to his left and saves the single.
Full delivery angling down leg, Milton Shumba looks to defend but misses and the ball hits his pads. Juts one run from the over and a wicket.
Mahmudullah serves a low full toss on the pads, Ryan Burl clips this towards deep mid-wicket for a single.
Angling into leg. Burl works it away with the angle towards mid-wicket.
Tad shorter and around off. Burl punches it to point.
Tossed up, on off. Burl drives it back to the bowler.
Ryan Burl walks out to the middle.

OUT! STUMPED! The captain of Zimbabwe has to depart now! Mahmudullah also has wicket from his very first ball! Mahmudullah flights this one full outside off, Craig Ervine charges really far down the wicket to play at the ball. Gets beaten on the inside edge as it goes through to the keeper. Anamul Haque makes an absolute meal of this first up as he spills the ball, but Craig Ervine is so far away that he can pick the ball up and breaks the stumps. Zimbabwe have lost half their side now.
This is slower through the air and around off. Shumba looks to defend but gets beaten.
Angling into leg. Ervine works it to deep mid-wicket for a single.
Mosaddek Hossain fires this onto the middle stump from 'round the wicket. Ervine blocks it out.
Milton Shumba is the next man in.

OUT! CAUGHT! Mosaddek Hossain gets his first wicket. This is short and on middle, angling in, Sean Williams tries to heave it over mid-wicket but the ball is too close to his body. He only manages to whip it in the air and straight into the hands of Najmul Hossain Shanto who takes a couple of steps to his right and pouches it safely at deep mid-wicket. Sean Williams will be not happy with himself as it was there to be hit and he managed to find the only fielder in deep. Zimbabwe four down now.
Commentary.Howout: c Najmul Hossain Shanto b Mosaddek Hossain

Commentary.Commentary: Another quciker one down the leg, Craig Ervine tries to flick it but misses. The ball hits his pads and rolls away towards short fine leg. They cross for a leg bye.
Darts this on on middle, angling in, Craig Ervine knocks it to the right of the bowler. Mosaddek Hossain runs to his right and collects it.
Mahedi Hasan flights this one full and outside off, Craig Ervine shuffles down the wicket and plays this to long on for another run. He will keep the strike and just 4 runs have come from this over.
Bowls this a fraction short and angled into the batter. Craig Ervine looks to flick and misses as the ball hit him on his thigh pad.
This is delivered full and in line with the stumps, Sean Williams takes an easy single as the ball is knocked to long on.
This one is full and outside off, Craig Ervine sweeps this to deep backward square leg for a single.
Bowls this one quicker and angled into the pads from a good length. Sean Williams looks to work this leg side and misses. Hits his pad and rolls to square leg for a leg bye.
Mahedi Hasan serves this full and angling into the pads, Sean Williams clips this to short mid-wicket.
Flatter and quicker around off, keeps a bit low, Craig Ervine makes room to cut it to point but ends up hitting towards covers.
A bit short again and on middle, Sean Williams slaps it to long on for a single.
Tossed up on the leg stump, Craig Ervine tries to flick it but gets an inside edge towards mid-wicket. They cross.
Slightly short and on middle and off, Craig Ervine goes on the back foot and pulls it wide of deep mid-wicket for a brace.
Floated full and on middle, Craig Ervine steps out and knocks it to short mid on.
Pushed through quciker and a bit short, on middle, Craig Ervine pushes it back to the bowler.
Another dot to end the over! Zimbabwe are 45-3 after the Powerplay! This is tad fuller and around off. Sean Williams drives it to covers.
Keeps bowling that tight line and length again, on off. Sean Williams just pushes it gently towards the off side.
No hat-trick for Mahedi Hasan! This is flatter and on off. Sean Williams blocks it off the front foot towards the off side.
Sean Williams walks out to the middle.

OUT! CAUGHT! Two wickets in a row! After a good start, Zimbabwe have just crumbled! Mahedi Hasan bowls it a tad short and it is angling down leg, Sikandar Raza goes for the sweep and top edges the ball to short fine leg. Mustafizur Rahman takes an easy catch and Bangladesh have the big wicket of Sikandar Raza! This man has tormented them in the last two games and they will be thrilled to see the back of him! Zimbabwe have lost three wickets now and they have a lot to do if they are to get back in this game! Can Mahedi Hasan get a hat-trick?
Commentary.Howout: c Mustafizur Rahman b Mahedi Hasan

Commentary.Commentary: Sikandar Raza is the next man in.

OUT! TIMBER! Mahedi Hasan strikes and the man in form Wesley Madhevere departs! Mehidy Hasan bowls a quick delivery on a full length, Wesley Madhevere gets down the wicket and yorks himself. The ball is headed straight for the leg stump as it is shattered and Zimbabwe lose a vital wicket!

LEG BYES! Four more added to the score! Mahedi Hasan begins with a full delivery outside off, Wesley Madhevere goes for the reverse sweep and misses. Hits him on his pads and runs down to the third man fence for four leg byes. Huge appeal but the impact is clearly outside off stump.
Mahedi Hasan is back on. One over for 8 runs so far.
Good end to the over by Hasan Mahmud. He goes fuller again and on middle, Craig Ervine knocks it back to the bowler.

A huge shout for LBW but turned down. This is full and on middle, angling into the batter, Wesley Madhevere plays down the wrong line and gets hit on the pads. There is a shout for LBW but the finger stays down. The ball defelects to the leg side of his pads and the batters get a leg bye.
FOUR! Brilliant shot! This is a bit short and wide of off stump, Wesley Madhevere picks the length early and cuts it past the diving point fielder for a boundary.
On a length and on off, Wesley Madhevere taps it to point.
Pulls his length back a bit and on middle, Craig Ervine stays back and tucks it through mid-wicket for one.
Good start from Hasan Mahmud. He bowls this full and on the fifth stump line from 'round the wicket, it shapes away a bit, Craig Ervine looks to drive it but gets beaten on the outside edge.
Another bowling change as Hasan Mahmud gets the ball now.
Tossed up on middle. Ervine skips down the track and pushes it to long on for a single.

FOUR! Top-edge but over the fielder and it runs away for another boundary! This is fuller on off. Ervine sweeps but gets a top edge. The ball luckily for him goes over the short fine leg fielder and runs away towards the fence.
On the shorter side, around off. Wesley Madhevere dabs it to backward point and takes a single.
Flatter on off. Wesley Madhevere looks to reverse-sweep it but misses. The ball hits his pads and there is an appeal but the umpire is not interested.

Another close call but Wesley Madhevere survives! This is slower through the air and around off. Wesley Madhevere looks to drive it away but misses. The keeper collects the ball and whips the bails off in a flash. There is an appeal for the stumping and the umpire takes it upstairs. However, the replays shows that Wesley Madhevere's back leg is just inside the crease and he survives here.
Wesley Madhevere is the new batter at the crease.

OUT! CAUGHT! Nasum Ahmed strikes in his very first over! Zimbabwe lose their first wicket! This is pushed quicker and tad shorter, around off. Regis Chakabva goes back and looks to punch it over covers. However, the ball hits the top of his blade and loops towards short cover. Afif Hossain there jumps and manages to pull off a stunner!
Commentary.Howout: c Afif Hossain b Nasum Ahmed

Commentary.Commentary: Nasum Ahmed has been given the ball now.
FOUR! Just over mid on and another boundary for Craig Ervine! This is fuller on middle. Ervine skips down the track and lifts it over mid on for a boundary.
Pushed quicker on middle. Ervine blocks it out.
Angling into middle. Regis Chakabva looks to work it towards the leg side. However, he gets a leading edge towards backward point for a single.
SIX! This time he clears the fence, this is good batting! Tossed up on middle. Regis Chakabva gets under it and launches it over cow corner for a maximum.
Goes fuller on middle. Regis Chakabva works it towards the leg side.
FOUR! Zimbabwe openers are looking positive here! This is on the shorter side on middle. Regis Chakabva goes for the reverse-hit and hits it well in front of square to the off side for a boundary.
Mosaddek Hossain brings himself on after just one over of pace.
Goes flatter on middle. Ervine works it towards the leg side.
SIX! First maximum of the game! This is tad slower through the air, on off. Ervine skips down the track, reaches the pitch of the ball and tonks it over long off for a biggie.
A flatter one on middle. It is an arm ball and Regis Chakabva works it towards the leg side for a single.
Slower through the air, on middle. Ervine sweeps it to deep square leg for a single.
Ervine skips down the wicket and Hasan pulls his length back, on off. Ervine only manages to defend it.
Tossed up, on middle. Ervine defends it off the front foot.
Mahedi Hasan to bowl from the other end.
A single to end the first over then. Mustafizur Rahman goes full again and around off, Craig Ervine opens the face of his bat and guides it to third man for a single.
BEATEN! This is on a good length and on off, shaping away. Craig Ervine comes down the track to play at it but misses it completely.
Full again and on middle, Regis Chakabva uses his feet and tries to go for the big shot but inside edges it towards square leg. They cross.
A bit of movement there. This is full and on middle, nips back in of the deck, Regis Chakabva knocks it towards mid-wicket with the inner half.
Fullish one and on middle, Regis Chakabva blocks it out.
FOUR! Zimbabwe and Regis Chakabva are underway with a boundary. This is a low full toss on off, Regis Chakabva just drives it through covers for a boundary. Not the start Bangladesh wanted.
We are all set to begin! The players are out in the middle. Regis Chakabva and Craig Ervine will open the innings for Zimbabwe. Mustafizur Rahman will begin proceedings with the new ball.

Mosaddek Hossain, the skipper of Bangladesh, says that they would have bowled first. Confirms that they have the same plans as the last game. They have some changes with just two fast bowlers and an extra spinner and adds that the wicket looks tricky. Tells that the spinners will come to play on this pitch.

Craig Ervine, the skipper of Zimbabwe says that they will bat first. He says it is a pretty good wicket and a good one to bat on. He says it looks dry and they will try to put runs on the board. He says that you are bound to lose wickets in the powerplay but that does not change their attacking approach. Informs they have three changes.

PITCH REPORT -  It is a pitch that was used for the first game, surface is very dry and really hard and there are some cracks as well. The weather is cool and it is slightly overcast. The outfield here is quick with long boundaries but once you find gap there is plenty of runs on this ground. The batters need to spend some time at the wicket and the runs will come freely. Bowlers need to bowl straight lines on this pitch.

Zimbabwe (Playing XI) - Regis Chakabva (WK), Craig Ervine (C), Wesley Madhevere, Sean Williams, Sikandar Raza, Milton Shumba, Ryan Burl, Luke Jongwe, John Masara (In place of Wellington Masakadza), Victor Nyauchi (In place of Richard Ngarava), Brad Evans (In place of Tanaka Chivanga).

Bangladesh (Playing XI) - Litton Das, Anamul Haque (WK), Najmul Hossain Shanto, Mosaddek Hossain (C), Parvez Hossain Emon (On debut) (In place of Munim Shahriar), Mahmudullah (In place of Nurul Hasan), Afif Hossain, Mahedi Hasan, Hasan Mahmud, Mustafizur Rahman, Nasum Ahmed (In place of Shoriful Islam).
TOSS - The coin goes up and lands in favour of Craig Ervine. Zimbabwe have elected to BAT first.

Bangladesh on the other hand, have a really young team and after losing Nurul Hasan to injury, they will now be led by Mosaddek Hossain. They have shown great fight in this series and despite losing the first game, they put on quite a show. The last game seemed like a walk in the park and credit goes to Mosaddek Hossain who has been outstanding this whole series. He pegged back the Zimbabweans early and if it wasn’t for Sikandar Raza, it could have been a very short game. Litton Das has shown good form with the bat and may prove to be the danger man for the hosts. Mahmudullah who is in Zimbabwe with the ODI team has been included in the squad for this game. With both teams looking to put their best foot forward, the anticipation builds for this exciting fixture. Do stay tuned for the toss and other updates.
